articles.title: Your uncle’s frozen Mac says it’s infected after viewing a Google ad. Now what?
articles.content: Ads appearing all over the Internet are trying to scam people.
articles.titleZh: 你叔叔的冰冻Mac说它在观看谷歌广告后感染了。现在怎么办？
articles.contentZh: 互联网上出现的广告试图欺骗人们。

articles.title: There's a new way to break RSA that's faster than anything we've seen before
articles.content: Until now, cryptographers thought factoring was the only way to break RSA. Not anymore.
articles.titleZh: 有一种打破RSA的新方法，比我们以前见过的任何方法都要快
articles.contentZh: 到目前为止，密码学家认为保理是破坏RSA的唯一方法。现在不是了。

articles.title: Microsoft disrupts AI-assisted platform that compromised 12,000 accounts
articles.content: EvilTokens provided an end-to-end platform that makes mass compromises faster and easier.
articles.titleZh: 微软颠覆了人工智能辅助平台，该平台入侵了12,000个账户
articles.contentZh: EvilTokens提供了一个端到端的平台，使大规模妥协更快、更容易。

articles.title: IT mistake erases 11 years of viewing history for hospitals’ maternity records
articles.content: The English hospitals recovered patient care data only.

articles.title: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion
articles.content: AMD announced today that it's acquiring World Labs, an AI research lab co-founded by the prominent researcher Dr. Fei-Fei Li, in an all-stock deal worth approximately $8.2 billion. World Labs launched in 2024 and was valued at $1 billion in a matter of months. The startup launched its first commercial product, a world generation model […]
articles.titleZh: AMD将以超过80亿美元的价格收购人工智能公司World Labs
